name: kneeling palm lifts
description: From hands and knees you lift the heels of your palms while the fingers stay planted. It strengthens the fingers and forearms for hand balancing.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and fingers spread.
Press your fingertips and finger pads firmly into the floor.
Lift the heels of your palms off the floor so your weight moves onto your fingers.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your palms with control.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders over your hands.
